description: Use this when the user describes a local service they want done in person (e.g. 'someone to fold my laundry', 'deep clean my apartment', 'a trainer who comes to my home') and you need Servana's category slug for search_vendors or estimate_service_request. Skip it if the request clearly fits one of these slugs: 'cleaning-and-organizing' (house cleaning, decluttering), 'laundry-washing' (wash and fold), 'med-spa' (botox, facials, skincare), 'yoga', 'personal-training', 'photography', 'home-services' (handyman, home upkeep), 'personal-services'. Do not use for online products, emergencies, or medical, legal or financial advice.

query.description: Short description of the task the user needs done (a task, not a category name)
